verdict.rationale: Capacity visibility is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. The pack documents instance types (docs-21), programmatic launch via the Cloud API (docs-5, docs-31) and 'first-come access' (docs-28), but nothing shows a console view or API endpoint reporting real-time GPU availability by type and region. The unofficial community CLI's ability to 'find' instances is a third-party tool and earns no credit.
